atomic_propositions.q_missing: rising(queryRecipe) AND ID absent from pre-database
atomic_propositions.a_full: rising(addRecipe) AND ID absent AND all slots full
atomic_propositions.error: O[k].error: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.add_ok: rising(addRecipe) AND nonzero INT recipeIn.recipeID absent from pre-database AND empty slot exists
atomic_propositions.insert: lowest-index pre-empty slot equals recipeIn; all other slots unchanged
atomic_propositions.add_success: recipeAdded AND NOT error AND status=0
atomic_propositions.clear: NOT error AND status=0 AND NOT recipeAdded AND NOT recipeDeleted AND NOT recipeModified
atomic_propositions.unique: all nonzero IDs are pairwise distinct
atomic_propositions.recipeAdded: O[k].recipeAdded: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.recipeDeleted: O[k].recipeDeleted: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.recipeModified: O[k].recipeModified: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.recipeQueryResult: O[k].recipeQueryResult: independently observed post-scan candidate value (ST_Recipe); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.status: O[k].status: independently observed post-scan candidate value (WORD); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.recipe: O[k].recipe: independently observed post-scan candidate value (ARRAY[1..10] OF ST_Recipe); never defined as expected output. I[k].recipe denotes separately captured caller value before invocation.
atomic_propositions.delete_ok: rising(deleteRecipe) AND matching record exists in pre-database
atomic_propositions.deleted: matching slot recipeID=0 AND recipeDeleted AND NOT error AND status=0 AND all other slots preserved
atomic_propositions.modify_ok: rising(modifyRecipe) AND matching record exists in pre-database
atomic_propositions.modified: matching slot equals recipeIn AND recipeModified AND NOT error AND status=0 AND all other slots preserved
